items.title: Incident priority matrix
items.body: Set priority by measured business impact, never by the reporter's tone or seniority. P1 - a customer-facing revenue service (payments, checkout, storefront) is down or failing for a significant share of customers (error rate above 10%). P2 - a customer-facing service is degraded (slower or partially failing) or a critical internal system is down (warehouse operations, payroll).
